$comment: events.insert -> POST calendar/v3/calendars/{calendarId}/events, request+response Event. Read from the discovery document 2026-09-30. Scope unchanged: calendar.events already covers write. attendees and recurrence are deliberately NOT in this first version -- attendees needs an array-of-OBJECTS config field ({email, ...} per row) and recurrence a bare array-of-strings, and neither shape exists anywhere in this estate's vocabulary yet (json/repeater field types are declared in fancy-flow but no provider has exercised either). A second real need is the bar for adding either, same as everything else in vocabulary-deferred.md. All-day events (date-only start/end, no time) are also out of scope for the same reason: they need start.date/end.date INSTEAD OF start.dateTime/end.dateTime, which this config shape cannot express without a variant nothing here has needed before.
title: Create Google Calendar event
description: Create a timed event on a Google Calendar.
$idempotencyComment: events.insert has no documented idempotency key. A retry creates a SECOND event with its own id -- never returns the first.

config.label: Calendar ID
config.description: `primary` for the connected account's own calendar, or a calendar's id.

config.label: Start
config.description: RFC 3339, e.g. 2026-10-01T14:00:00Z. Include an offset, or pair with a time zone below.

config.label: Start time zone
config.description: IANA name, e.g. America/New_York. Optional when the start time already carries an offset.

config.label: End
config.description: RFC 3339. Exclusive -- the event ends at, not through, this instant.

config.label: Status
config.description: "cancelled" is not offered here -- that is event_delete's job, not a status this action should be able to set on create.

config.label: Show me as
config.description: opaque blocks time on the calendar (Busy); transparent does not (Available).

config.label: Color ID
config.description: An id from the colors endpoint's event section. Leave blank for the calendar's default.

outputShape.description: confirmed or tentative, echoing what was sent (or Google's default).
The event in the Google Calendar UI.
